title: DigitalWitnessSegmentProof
description: Sidecar integrity proof emitted per recorded MP4 segment (one '<segment>.proof.json' per segment). Produced by integrity/ProofManager.kt and validated by tools/verify_chain.py. Fields under 'evidence mode only' are omitted in anonymous mode, where they would otherwise link recordings to one device. This supersedes the earlier (never-shipped) chunks[]/merkleRoots layout.

version.description: v3 compatibility or v4 metadata-bound proof

sessionId.description: Recording session UUID; one chain per session in both modes.

segmentIndex.description: Zero-based index of this segment within the session/chain.

segmentFilename.description: Random stable media basename. Content-hash lookup also supports legacy renamed downloads.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the MP4 segment bytes.

telemetrySha256.description: SHA-256 of the sensor-telemetry sidecar bytes (present when telemetry was captured). Resolved by content hash, not filename.

telemetryFilename.description: Original local telemetry sidecar filename ('<segment>.telemetry.json'). Same UUID-rename caveat as segmentFilename.

segmentHash.description: v3: SHA256(mediaDigest || optionalTelemetryDigest), or mediaDigest alone without telemetry. v4: SHA256(mediaDigest || optionalTelemetryDigest || SHA256(decodedMetadataBytes)).

prevChainHash.description: Previous chain head. For segmentIndex 0 this is H_0 = SHA256(sessionId || beacon.randomness || salt) (or SHA256(sessionId || salt) when no beacon was fetched).

chainHash.description: This segment's chain head = SHA256(segmentHash || prevChainHash).

chainSeed.description: Inputs to re-derive H_0 (first segment) and confirm the drand lower time bound.

salt.description: Base64 (no-wrap) 16-byte random salt folded into H_0.

timestampUnix.description: Proof creation time, Unix seconds. Floored to the hour in anonymous mode.

timestampIso.description: Proof creation time, ISO-8601 UTC. Floored to the hour in anonymous mode.

deviceSignature.description: Evidence mode only. Base64 ECDSA P-256 signature over the raw bytes of chainHash.

publicKey.description: Evidence mode only. Base64 X.509/DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo of the device signing key.

captureParams.description: Evidence mode only. Encoder settings (device-capability fingerprint, hence omitted in anonymous mode).

deviceAttestation.description: Evidence mode only, embedded once (first segment that finds it). Hardware key-attestation proving a genuine StrongBox/TEE-backed Android key was bound to a fresh per-session challenge.

challengeAlgorithm.description: How the attestation challenge was derived, e.g. 'SHA256(sessionId‖beaconRandomness)'.

chain.description: Certificate chain, leaf-first, each a base64 (no-wrap) X.509 DER certificate. Validate to the Google hardware attestation root.

environment.description: Mode-aware environmental metadata from integrity/EnvironmentCapture.kt. Rich in evidence mode (device/network/sensors); minimized in anonymous mode (motion/magnetic sensors and transport type dropped; presence-only network).

metadata.description: v4: standard Base64 of exact UTF-8 JSON metadata bytes; hash bytes directly rather than reserializing.

recovery.description: Optional v4 bound declaration for recovered packets. The proof timestamp is recovery/construction time; gaps and an unflushed tail can be missing.

beacon.description: drand randomness beacon (lower time bound). A verifier re-fetches 'round' from any drand relay and confirms 'randomness' matches.

round.description: drand round number (its time is public and immutable).
